messages:
jen_support: Hey team — ACME reported 403 'permission denied' when switching into Project `acme-prod` after we rolled out an MFA-required claim from the IdP last night. Login via SSO succeeds, org list visible, clicking project returns 403. Repro: 1) SSO login 2) click org 3) switch project -> 403. Any ideas?

mike_idp: Can you paste the exact 403 payload / any auth headers? Is the token scope being trimmed by the claim change? @ashley_sre fyi.

jen_support: Response body: `{"error":"forbidden","message":"insufficient_permissions"}`. Headers show `x-session-id` and `set-cookie`. I grabbed a redacted id_token claims blob — has `amr: [\"mfa\"]` and `groups: [\"acme-admins\"]`. But `session_scope` claim is missing compared to a working token from before.

ashley_sre: Quick hypothesis: IdP attribute rename caused our session-authorizer to drop project scopes. We previously read `mfa_enforced` claim; IdP now sends `mfa`. If session code requires the old claim name we might invalidate cached session roles.

jen_support: That matches timing — customer started seeing errors after IdP pushed an attribute change ~03:10 UTC. Customer says some users (older active sessions) can still access, new sign-ins get 403.

kai_support: Temporary customer workaround: ask affected users to fully sign out or open an incognito window and sign in again. Org admin can also use "Refresh SSO session" in the org settings to rehydrate roles. That immediately unblocked one user. :thumbsup:

mike_idp: Confirmed — upstream renamed attribute `mfa_enforced` -> `mfa` in SCIM push at 03:12 UTC. I'll add a compatibility layer in mapping so we accept either claim.

ashley_sre: I'll file a bug: ENG-identity #4523. Proposed immediate fix: accept both claim names and add a migration step to reconcile existing sessions (force session refresh on next token exchange). Long term: add unit test for claim rename handling.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout identity-service v2.3.1 to prod (canary -> 50%) for claim-compat fallback. CI/CD run: https://ci.redwood-inference/1234/logs

jen_support: Customer applied incognito workaround and confirmed access restored for 4/4 users. They'll wait for the permanent patch but asked for ETA.

mike_idp: ETA for full rollout ~2 hours; will monitor error rate. I'll post follow-up when rollout completes.

jen_support: Thanks — marking incident as downgraded. I'll follow up with ACME once deploy finishes.

ashley_sre: Note for runbook update: add a section about claim renames and the "refresh SSO session" admin action.

mike_idp: update: rollout completed at 4300012680, error spike returned to baseline.

jen_support: Confirmed customer happy. Closing thread for now. :party_parrot:
